rule:
Fixed rule: the array with most product-forming pairs; the larger-share role; its molecule with most fully measured product-forming partners (then fewest heavy atoms, SMILES); four such partners
(fewest heavy atoms); four comparison pairs: fully measured product-forming pairs containing neither the shared molecule nor any of its four partners, in order of the SHA-256 of the pair identifier, each kept only if it shares no molecule with a pair already kept (2026-10-13).
